title: Structural bounded proper flat model
statement: Structural bounded model with concentrated, flat, quasi-coherent, finitely presented terms.

proof.text: Let M be the free sheaf on the empty type, a zero object by the free-sheaf Hom equivalence. Its standard local presentation has no generators and no relations, so it is finitely presented and quasi-coherent. Define C explicitly with M in every degree and all differentials zero. Since every term is zero, C is strictly concentrated both above and below 0. Evaluation preserves zero morphisms, hence all sections of M are zero modules. Such modules are free and therefore flat over every base ring, in particular under the scalar restriction defining IsFlatOver for the identity. Take a = b = 0. No identification with a direct image is required by the statement.

theorem exists_proper_flat_boundedPresentation_model_core {X T : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ T) (F : X.Modules)
    [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [HasInjectiveResolutions X.Modules] [F.IsFinitePresentation]
    (hF : F.IsFlatOver f) (U : T.Opens) (hU : IsAffine U.toScheme) :
    ∃ (C : CochainComplex U.toScheme.Modules ℤ) (a : ℤ) (b : ℕ),
      C.IsStrictlyGE a ∧ C.IsStrictlyLE b ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, (C.X n).IsFlatOver (𝟙 U.toScheme)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, (C.X n).IsQuasicoherent) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, (C.X n).IsFinitePresentation)
